Equate the curve and straight line equations to find points of intersection:
$$2x^2 + 5 = mx - 3 \implies 2x^2 - mx + 8 = 0$$

Apply the condition for no real intersections (strictly negative discriminant $\Delta < 0$):
$$b^2 - 4ac < 0 \implies (-m)^2 - 4(2)(8) < 0 \implies m^2 - 64 < 0$$

Solve the quadratic inequality for $m$:
$$(m - 8)(m + 8) < 0 \implies -8 < m < 8 \quad (\text{or } (-8, 8))$$
